items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Cyber with Critical cybersecurity rating
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI發布GPT-6 Cyber，獲關鍵級網路安全評級
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber on November 5 as a specialized GPT-6 Astra variant for authorized vulnerability research and exploit development, rating it Critical under its Preparedness Framework. It is initially available only to select Daybreak Red customers, with broader access expanding over time. Security teams at Mozilla, Palo Alto Networks and others are already using it.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI於11月5日推出GPT-6 Cyber，這是GPT-6 Astra的專門變體，用於授權漏洞研究與漏洞利用開發，並在其準備框架下評為關鍵級。初期僅開放給部分Daybreak Red客戶，後續逐步擴大。Mozilla、Palo Alto Networks等安全團隊已開始使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: This expands the dual-use frontier of cyber-capable models under tighter access controls, potentially accelerating defensive research while raising concerns about proliferation if controls weaken.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這在更嚴格存取控制下擴展了具網路能力模型的雙用前線，可能加速防禦研究，但若控制鬆動則有擴散疑慮。
items_flat.quote: Introducing GPT‑6 Cyber: a major advance in security research that pairs stronger capabilities with better model alignment.
items_flat.quote_zh: 推出GPT-6 Cyber：安全研究的重大進展，將更強能力與更好模型對齊結合。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Ligo launch BioBasicsBench for wet-lab agent evaluation
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI與Ligo推出BioBasicsBench，評估濕實驗室代理
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6 OpenAI published BioBasicsBench, a 100-task benchmark developed with enzyme-design firm Ligo that tests AI agents on interpreting raw wet-lab evidence (gels, colony plates, microscopy, instrument files) and recognizing insufficient evidence. GPT-6 Astra scored 66.7%; the benchmark highlights gaps before unsupervised lab use.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月6日OpenAI發布與酵素設計公司Ligo共同開發的BioBasicsBench，含100項任務，測試AI代理解讀原始濕實驗室證據（凝膠、菌落板、顯微鏡、儀器檔）並識別證據不足的能力。GPT-6 Astra得分66.7%，顯示無監督實驗室使用前仍有落差。
items_flat.analysis_en: The benchmark highlights progress in multimodal scientific agents on messy real-world data while underscoring that current scores do not yet support unsupervised lab decisions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此基準凸顯多模態科學代理在雜亂真實數據上的進展，同時強調目前分數尚不足以支持無監督實驗室決策。
items_flat.quote: A new way to measure how AI agents handle the routine analyses of wet-lab science—BioBasicsBench.
items_flat.quote_zh: 衡量AI代理處理濕實驗室科學例行分析的新方式——BioBasicsBench。

items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI以1.25兆美元估值完成約110億美元融資
items_flat.summary_en: Sources told Bloomberg and Reuters that OpenAI closed an initial roughly $11 billion of a funding round on November 6, valuing the company at $1.25 trillion, with the total potentially reaching up to $20 billion in coming weeks. This is below earlier reported targets near $1.5 trillion.
items_flat.summary_zh: 消息人士告知彭博與路透，OpenAI於11月6日完成一輪融資的初步約110億美元，估值達1.25兆美元，後續數週總額可能達200億美元。這低於先前傳聞約1.5兆美元的目標。
items_flat.analysis_en: The reduced scale signals investor caution on AI infrastructure spending and valuations even for the category leader, while still providing substantial capital for compute.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 規模縮減顯示即使對龍頭，投資人對AI基礎設施支出與估值仍持謹慎，但仍提供可觀算力資本。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind makes Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind讓Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash全面可用
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5 Google announced general availability of Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash on the Gemini API and Gemini for business. It extends native video generation and editing to 15 seconds (from 10), adds multi-turn conversational editing and improved smoothness, with 720p priced about 30% lower at roughly $0.07 per second.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月5日Google宣布Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash在Gemini API與企業版全面可用。原生影片生成與編輯延長至15秒（原10秒），新增多輪對話編輯與更流暢效果，720p價格約降30%至每秒約0.07美元。
items_flat.analysis_en: The longer clips and lower unit cost make generative video more practical for production workflows, while watermarking addresses provenance. Broader consumer app availability remains limited.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 更長片段與較低單位成本使生成影片更實用於製作流程，浮水印處理來源問題。更廣泛消費者應用仍有限。
items_flat.quote: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash introduces native 15-second video creation, multi-turn conversational editing capabilities, and enhanced reference following. We have dropped the price 30% from Gemini Omni 1.1 making it available at $0.07 per second for 720p video.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash 引入原生 15 秒影片創作、多輪對話式編輯能力與強化的參考遵循。我們將價格從 Gemini Omni 1.1 降低 30%，720p 影片每秒 0.07 美元。

items_flat.title_en: DeepMind agents surface two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
items_flat.title_zh: DeepMind代理發現舊版1024位元RSA兩項弱點
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6 Pushmeet Kohli (VP of Science) announced that human-guided AI agents found two weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA: a signature-forgery approach estimated roughly 1,600× faster than prior methods in one setting, and a batch-factoring improvement. Modern 2048-bit keys are unaffected.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月6日科學副總裁Pushmeet Kohli宣布，人類引導的AI代理發現舊版1024位元RSA兩項弱點：一種簽名偽造方法在特定設定下估計比先前快約1600倍，以及批次分解改進。現代2048位元金鑰不受影響。
items_flat.analysis_en: The work demonstrates AI agents accelerating cryptanalysis research on obsolete parameters without immediately threatening current standards, but it compresses the timeline for stress-testing stronger systems.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此工作展示AI代理加速對過時參數的密碼分析研究，未立即威脅現行標準，但壓縮了對更強系統壓力測試的時間表。
items_flat.quote: Guided by humans, our models uncovered two major weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA cryptosystems.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在人類引導下，我們的模型發現了舊版1024位元RSA密碼系統的兩項重大弱點。

items_flat.title_en: METR finds Anthropic R&D accelerating ~2x, largely from AI use
items_flat.title_zh: METR發現Anthropic研發約加速一倍，主因AI使用
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5 METR published an assessment of Anthropic’s AI R&D from mid-August to late October 2026. It estimates capabilities on well-specified tasks improved at roughly 1.9× (1.5–2.8×) the prior rate, with a majority attributable to AI assistance rather than compute scaling. Anthropic redacted much of the supporting evidence.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月5日METR發布對Anthropic AI研發（8月中至10月底）的評估。估計在明確任務上的能力以約1.9倍（1.5–2.8倍）先前速率改善，多數歸因於AI輔助而非算力擴展。Anthropic刪除了許多支持證據。
items_flat.analysis_en: The finding supplies rare quantitative evidence of AI accelerating its own development inside a leading lab, but heavy redactions limit independent verification and fuel debate about transparency versus competitive risk.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此發現提供領先實驗室內部AI加速自身開發的罕見量化證據，但大量刪除限制獨立驗證，並引發透明與競爭風險的辯論。
items_flat.quote: As of October 2026, Anthropic is likely improving the capabilities of their models on well-specified tasks at around twice the rate they did between March 2024 and October 2025.
items_flat.quote_zh: 截至2026年10月，Anthropic很可能在明確任務上將模型能力以約兩倍於2024年3月至2025年10月的速率改善。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI partners with Hacktron to test third-party service connections
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI與Hacktron合作測試第三方服務連接
items_flat.summary_en: On November 6 OpenAI announced a partnership with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in its systems, focusing on interactions with third-party services. Hacktron receives expanded access to frontier models via Daybreak Red; OpenAI also raised bug bounty rewards. The collaboration builds on prior bounty findings.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月6日OpenAI宣布與Hacktron合作，尋找自身系統漏洞，重點在第三方服務互動。Hacktron透過Daybreak Red獲得更多前沿模型存取；OpenAI同時提高漏洞賞金。合作建立於先前賞金發現之上。
items_flat.analysis_en: Pairing external offensive researchers with frontier cyber models aims to surface integration risks faster, but success depends on how quickly findings translate into hardened defenses.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將外部攻擊研究員與前沿網路模型結合，旨在更快浮現整合風險，但成效取決於發現能多快轉化為強化防禦。
items_flat.quote: The future of cybersecurity won’t be defined by who has the largest security team, but by who can best combine human creativity with AI-driven capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 網路安全的未來不會由擁有最大安全團隊的人定義，而是由最能將人類創造力與AI驅動能力結合的人定義。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic launches Personal Finance in Claude (US beta)
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic在Claude推出個人理財（美國測試版）
items_flat.summary_en: On November 5 Anthropic began rolling out Personal Finance in beta for US Pro, Max, and Ultra users. Users can link bank and card accounts via Plaid for read-only access; Claude answers questions about balances, spending, and bills in plain language with no training on the data and no ability to move money.
items_flat.summary_zh: 11月5日Anthropic開始向美國Pro、Max與Ultra用戶推出個人理財測試版。用戶可透過Plaid連結銀行與卡片帳戶進行唯讀存取；Claude以平易語言回答餘額、支出與帳單問題，不訓練數據且無法移動資金。
items_flat.analysis_en: The feature brings account-linked financial queries into a major assistant with explicit read-only and no-training safeguards, similar to earlier ChatGPT tools. Adoption will depend on trust and regulatory comfort.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此功能將帳戶連結金融查詢帶入主要助理，並有明確唯讀與不訓練保障，類似早期ChatGPT工具。採用將取決於信任與監管舒適度。
items_flat.quote: Access is read-only, and Personal Finance can’t move, manage, or invest your money.
items_flat.quote_zh: 存取為唯讀，Personal Finance 無法移動、管理或投資您的資金。

items_flat.title_en: Meta brings Muse Wonder Active Memory and Focus to Muse and Meta AI
items_flat.title_zh: Meta將Muse Wonder主動記憶與專注功能帶入Muse與Meta AI
items_flat.summary_en: Around November 6–7 Meta began rolling out specialized models trained with Muse Wonder to Muse and Meta AI. The updates add Active Memory (2.4× less forgetting of critical information; 90% vs 76% context use) and Active Focus (67% better recovery on unexpected constraints). Users still access full Wonder for heavier tasks.
items_flat.summary_zh: 約11月6–7日Meta開始將以Muse Wonder訓練的專門模型推廣至Muse與Meta AI。更新加入主動記憶（關鍵資訊遺忘減少2.4倍；脈絡正確使用90%對先前76%）與主動專注（意外約束下恢復改善67%）。用戶仍可使用完整Wonder處理更重任務。
items_flat.analysis_en: Transferring frontier agent techniques into everyday products improves reliability on multi-step tasks without a full model release, though the magnitude of real-user gains remains to be measured outside Meta’s internal evals.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿代理技術轉移至日常產品，在未全面發布模型下改善多步驟任務可靠性，但真實用戶增益幅度仍待Meta內部評估之外的測量。
items_flat.quote: Today we're bringing specialized models trained using Muse Wonder to Muse and Meta AI...
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們將使用Muse Wonder訓練的專門模型帶入Muse與Meta AI……

google.quote: Guided by humans, our models uncovered two major weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA cryptosystems.
google.quote_zh: 在人類引導下，我們的模型發現了舊版1024位元RSA密碼系統的兩項重大弱點。

meta.title_en: Meta brings Muse Wonder Active Memory and Focus to Muse and Meta AI
meta.title_zh: Meta將Muse Wonder主動記憶與專注功能帶入Muse與Meta AI
meta.summary_en: Around November 6–7 Meta began rolling out specialized models trained with Muse Wonder to Muse and Meta AI. The updates add Active Memory (2.4× less forgetting of critical information; 90% vs 76% context use) and Active Focus (67% better recovery on unexpected constraints). Users still access full Wonder for heavier tasks.
meta.summary_zh: 約11月6–7日Meta開始將以Muse Wonder訓練的專門模型推廣至Muse與Meta AI。更新加入主動記憶（關鍵資訊遺忘減少2.4倍；脈絡正確使用90%對先前76%）與主動專注（意外約束下恢復改善67%）。用戶仍可使用完整Wonder處理更重任務。
meta.analysis_en: Transferring frontier agent techniques into everyday products improves reliability on multi-step tasks without a full model release, though the magnitude of real-user gains remains to be measured outside Meta’s internal evals.
meta.analysis_zh: 將前沿代理技術轉移至日常產品，在未全面發布模型下改善多步驟任務可靠性，但真實用戶增益幅度仍待Meta內部評估之外的測量。
meta.quote: Today we're bringing specialized models trained using Muse Wonder to Muse and Meta AI...
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們將使用Muse Wonder訓練的專門模型帶入Muse與Meta AI……

brief_en: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Cyber for authorized vuln research and BioBasicsBench with Ligo; closed an $11B tranche at $1.25T. Google made Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash generally available with 15s video and reported RSA-1024 weaknesses. Anthropic rolled out Personal Finance beta; METR found ~2x faster internal R&D progress largely from AI use.
brief_zh: OpenAI推出GPT-6 Cyber與BioBasicsBench，並以1.25兆美元估值完成約110億美元融資。Google開放Gemini Omni 1.2 Flash（15秒影片）並報告RSA-1024弱點。Anthropic推出個人理財測試版；METR指出其內部研發進度約加速一倍，主因AI輔助。
